'''Koh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] from [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]] and was one of the followers of [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] [[Gentis]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during [[Ghost Prison incident|his coup]]. He was also a demolitions expert, and during the [[Battle on Coruscant|Palpatine's retaking of Coruscant]] Koh was ordered by Gentis to hit Vader and his new forces with grenades, but the ex-[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] sniper [[Shonn Volta]] shot Koh before he could throw the armed explosives, which detonated in the midst of the cadets.<ref name="Ghost Prison" />
